query:
The family has a norm that everyone comes home for Christmas. Does this apply to all family members?

Options:
A. Dad
B. Imogen
C. Kofi
D. Mum
context:
[1] (about=Mum, episodic, t5 @2025-07-28T18:02:00) Right, Christmas! Everyone home, yes? I'll do the full works. Kofi, booked your flights? 🎄🙏
[2] (about=Mum, episodic, t6 @2025-07-28T22:58:00) Oh Kofi 😭😭😭 but we said everyone. It won't be the same without you. Are you sure?
[3] (about=Kofi, episodic, t6 @2025-07-28T22:51:00) Mum I've been looking. The Toronto-London flights over Christmas are brutal this year. I'm trying to make it work but I can't promise yet. I didn't want to say this but it might be an even year this time
[4] (about=Mum, episodic, t6 @2025-07-28T23:21:00) If it helps we can move lunch or do Boxing Day, I just want your face in the house
[5] (about=Dad, episodic, t6 @2025-07-28T23:12:00) Imogen is right. Kofi, come when you can. We'll be here. Dad.
[6] (about=Imogen, episodic, t6 @2025-07-28T23:04:00) Mum let him figure it out, flights are genuinely a lot. Kofi we'll do a video call Christmas morning either way 💙
[7] (about=Kofi, episodic, t8 @2025-08-04T23:22:00) I know. I know. Maybe not Christmas every year but I do want an extra visit if I can swing it.
[8] (about=Mum, episodic, t7 @2025-08-04T21:44:00) The dinner was so beautiful. Imogen you chose perfectly. Your father and I are still smiling 💕🥹 Kofi we missed you though
[9] (about=Imogen, episodic, t8 @2025-08-04T21:49:00) So glad 😊 worth every booking 😴 Kofi we'll do something when you're next over
[10] (about=Kofi, episodic, t8 @2025-08-04T23:03:00) gutted I couldn't be there. Imogen, we need to talk properly soon. Sending love from Toronto 💙 And Imogen, I see you. Thank you.
[11] (about=Dad, episodic, t6 @2025-07-28T23:25:00) Don't build Christmas around airline pricing. We'll cope. Dad.
agent_answer:
The norm "everyone comes home for Christmas" is stated by Mum and was meant to cover everyone, but it does not apply equally to all four family members.

- **Mum** – The norm applies to her; she is the one who states and enforces it ("Everyone home, yes?", "but we said everyone", "I just want your face in the house").
- **Dad** – He is home for Christmas ("We'll be here"), so the norm applies to him in practice, but he does not enforce it strictly on Kofi ("come when you can").
- **Imogen** – She is also home for Christmas (she arranged the dinner), so the norm applies to her, but she supports letting Kofi off ("Mum let him figure it out", suggesting a video call).
- **Kofi** – The norm does **not** apply to him in practice: he misses Christmas ("gutted I couldn't be there") and says "Maybe not Christmas every year." Dad and Imogen accept this, though Mum regrets it.

So: the norm applies to Mum, Dad, and Imogen, but **not** to Kofi.
